audit_items.proof_trace: After flash loan, post(underlying_balance) = pre(underlying_balance) + fee_coin.value() where fee_coin >= 1 always: the borrow path asserts fee != 0 (market.move:814), the repay path asserts fee_coin != 0 after any referral rebate (market.move:851), and reserve.repay_flash_loan joins both principal (restoring pre-balance) and fee_coin into underlying_balance, strictly increasing it. The hot-potato FlashLoan struct forces borrow and repay in the same Sui transaction, leaving no window for state inconsistency.
